verdict.rationale: Bolna supports batch calling via CLI (manage 'batches' from terminal) and API-driven multi-step outreach sequences across many contacts, plus bulk power of 'thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute', indicating bulk operation capability. However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk-edit/bulk-update API for agents, templates, or other resources beyond calls. missing for 10: explicit bulk CRUD operations across non-call resources (agents, templates, phone numbers), independent/hands-on confirmation of batch call limits or performance at scale.
